sn35.134:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati devadahaṃ nāma sakyānaṃ nigamo.
sn35.134:1.3: nāhaṃ bhikkhave sabbesaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi. na ca panāhaṃ bhikkhave, sabbesaññeva bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu nāppamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn35.134:1.4: ye te bhikkhave, bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaññojanā sammadaññā vimuttā, tesāhaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu nāppamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn35.134:1.6: kataṃ tesaṃ appamādena, abhabbā te pamajjituṃ.
sn35.134:1.7: ye ca kho tehi bhikkhave, bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti, tesāhaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi.
sn35.134:1.9: santi bhikkhave, cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā manoramāpi amanoramāpi.
sn35.134:1.10: tyāssa phussa phussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti.
sn35.134:1.11: cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
sn35.134:1.12: imaṃ khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi. santi bhikkhave, sotaviññeyyā saddā manoramāpi amanoramāpi …pe… santi bhikkhave, ghānaviññeyyā gandhā manoramāpi amanoramāpi …pe… santi bhikkhave, jivhāviññeyyā rasā manoramāpi amanoramāpi …pe… santi bhikkhave, kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā manoramāpi amanoramāpi …pe…
sn35.134:1.13: santi bhikkhave manoviññeyyā dhammā manoramāpi amanoramāpi.
sn35.134:1.14: tyāssa phussa phussa cittaṃ na pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti.
sn35.134:1.15: cetaso apariyādānā āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati apammuṭṭhā, passaddho kāyo asāraddho, samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
sn35.134:1.16: imaṃ khvāhaṃ bhikkhave, appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno tesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ chasu phassāyatanesu appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmīti.
